label: Expanded Aymara-Bolivian decolonial critique into community feminism
description: Sharing La Paz’s insurgent Aymara intellectual milieu with Rivera Cusicanqui, Paredes developed feminismo comunitario to confront both colonial racism and internal Indigenous patriarchy.
dialecticalTension: Articulates body-territory politics against dual colonial and ancestral patriarchies.
historicalContext: Mujeres Creando & Comunidad Mujeres Creando Comunidad (1992–2010).

citations.author: Julieta Paredes
citations.work: Hilando fino desde el feminismo comunitario

label: Paired coloniality of gender critique with Aymara entronque patriarcal
description: While engaging Lugones’s decoloniality of gender, Paredes stressed that precolonial communities also held patriarchal hierarchies that fused (entronque) with European colonialism.
dialecticalTension: Refines decolonial feminism against romanticized precolonial innocence.
